title: Kubernetes developer flashcards: for the Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) exam
releaseBlockers: the exam hosts' Helm version (Helm 4 is out) and container build tool are not published: check Helm cards against the version used
description: CKAD: every idea explained before it is tested, every card quoting the source words it rests on.
sourceShort: the Kubernetes documentation and the CNCF curriculum

glossary.SSH: Secure Shell, for logging in to a remote machine
glossary.CIDR: Classless Inter-Domain Routing, a way of writing an IP address range such as 10.0.0.0/16
glossary.JSON: JavaScript Object Notation, a text format for data
glossary.TLS: Transport Layer Security, the encryption used by HTTPS
glossary.UID: user ID, the number Linux uses for a user
glossary.GID: group ID, the number Linux uses for a group

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 479 cards against the Kubernetes, Helm and CNCF documentation they quote, word for word as found by the card checker
checks.result: 4 cards marked wrong were fixed or rechecked: three (an HTTP probe redirect, what fsGroup does, a Secret type) are now right against their sources, and one (invalid ConfigMap keys with envFrom) was confirmed right against the live page. 1 unsupported claim, 4 ambiguous cards, 6 unclear ones and 3 minor issues were also fixed.
